meta.name: add-clidash
meta.description: Add clidash — a zero-dependency, read-only web dashboard that derives its tabs and tables at runtime from any CLI that lists resources as JSON. Ships pre-wired for NanoClaw's ncl CLI (agent groups, sessions, channels, users, roles), plus message-activity charts, a log tail, and a read-only file viewer for group skills/CLAUDE.md/profiles.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将任意 JSON 输出 CLI 转为实时 Web 仪表盘
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你有输出 JSON 的 CLI 工具，想快速生成 Web 仪表盘
copy.tagline_en: Turn any JSON-output CLI into a live web dashboard
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a CLI that outputs JSON and want a quick web dashboard

howto.what: 将 clidash（一个只读的网页仪表盘）复制到项目并生成配置。它会读取 CLI 输出的 JSON，自动生成标签页和表格；预置了 NanoClaw 的 ncl 配置，并提供消息活动图表、日志尾部和只读文件查看器。
howto.when: 当你要求“添加 clidash”或“安装这个仪表盘”时触发。该技能会复制工具目录、创建配置文件，并提示运行测试。

say.text: 帮我添加 clidash 仪表盘。
say.note: 技能会复制工具目录并创建配置文件。

say.text: 把 clidash 配置好并运行测试。
say.note: 会执行复制、配置和 npm test。

say.text: 用 clidash 显示 NanoClaw 的资源。
say.note: 配置后仪表盘会展示 ncl 各组、会话等。

howto.what_en: Adds clidash, a zero-dependency read-only web dashboard, to the project. It derives tabs and tables at runtime from any CLI that outputs JSON resources, and ships pre-wired for NanoClaw's ncl CLI with activity charts, log tail, and read-only file viewer.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add clidash or install this dashboard. The skill copies the tool directory, creates the config, and suggests running tests.

say_en.note: Copies the tool directory and creates the config file.

say_en.text: Set up clidash and run the tests.
say_en.note: Performs copy, config, and npm test.

say_en.text: Use clidash to show NanoClaw resources.
say_en.note: Displays ncl groups, sessions, etc. after config.
